newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Surveillance buys biomed labs in Australia, Peru.
newsitem.headline: Surveillance buys biomed labs in Australia, Peru.

text.p: Swiss inspection and testing group Societe Generale de Surveillance said it had acquired a majority stake in Melbourne Pathology, a leading provider of pathology services and biomedical tests in Australia.

In a statement, SGS said that Melbourne Pathology had turnover equal to 48 million swiss francs in the year to June 1996 and employed 600 people. "Melbourne Pathology represents a significant extension to SGS's activities in Australia."

SGS, world leader in inspections and testing, also said it had acquired a majority interest in Instituto de Diagnostico Cantella Colicon, a Lima-based medical laboratory. Turnover for 1995 was the equivalent of 1.2 million swiss francs.
